resume:
RIYA MEHTA
Product Analyst | Bengaluru, India | riya.mehta@example.com | LinkedIn | GitHub

Target Profile
Product Analyst with 3 years of experience in consumer subscription funnels, event instrumentation, A/B testing, and executive analytics. Strongest work sits at the intersection of event taxonomy, causal measurement, and product decision-making.

Experience
Product Analyst II — BrightCart Consumer Commerce                                                   Jul 2024 - Present
SQL, BigQuery, Amplitude, Python, Experimentation, Funnel Analytics
- Rebuilt checkout and onboarding event taxonomy for a 1.8M MAU grocery commerce product, defining 42 canonical events and 76 required properties across acquisition, cart, payment, refund, and subscription flows; this reduced duplicate event definitions by 38% and made weekly funnel readouts consistent across product, growth, and finance.
- Increased new-user checkout completion from 31.2% to 44.8% by diagnosing a wallet-verification drop-off, separating first-attempt failures from retry-success cases, and shipping a two-step verification experiment with guardrails on payment failure rate and support contacts.
- Ran a 6-week free-delivery threshold experiment that lifted subscription trial starts from 9.6% to 13.1% while keeping contribution margin within -1.8%; analysis used city-level stratification, pre-period basket-size cohorts, and cancellation-rate guardrails.
- Designed an experiment-readout template used by 5 PMs that required hypothesis, exposure definition, metric denominator, pre-period balance checks, and decision recommendation before launch review.

Product Analyst — LearnLoop Subscription Learning                                                     Jun 2022 - Jun 2024
SQL, Python, Mixpanel, dbt, Retention, Cohorts
- Improved D30 lesson-retention from 22% to 34% by identifying that completion nudges helped new learners but hurt returning learners; recommended segment-specific nudges after cohorting by first-week lesson depth and notification fatigue.
- Built a churn-risk dashboard for subscription learners that combined missed weekly goals, lesson streak breaks, and payment retry outcomes; customer-success team used it to prioritize save campaigns, raising winback conversion from 6.4% to 10.2%.
- Partnered with engineering to backfill historical lesson events after a schema migration; documented which pre-migration events were safe for trend analysis and which were only valid for post-migration cohort cuts.

Data Analyst — Northstar Commerce                                                                      Jan 2021 - May 2022
SQL, Excel, Looker, Campaign Analytics
- Automated weekly growth dashboard across CAC, first-order conversion, reorder rate, and payback period for 3 acquisition channels, cutting manual reporting time from 4 hours to 25 minutes.
- Found that a reported 18% reorder-rate lift was mostly mix shift from returning users; revised the readout using first-order month cohorts and changed the team recommendation from scale-up to holdout retest.

Education
B.Tech, Computer Science and Engineering — PES University

Technical Skills
SQL, BigQuery, Python, Pandas, Amplitude, Mixpanel, Looker, dbt, Google Sheets, A/B Testing, Cohort Analysis, Funnel Analysis, Event Taxonomy, Causal Inference Basics
